label: Whatever is in act in some respect and in POTENCY_2 in some respect is composite
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever is in act in some respect and in potency in some respect is composite, under the supplied Composite predicate of the q.3 a.7 readings. The thought: a being whose actual being leaves a capacity unrealized has two principles, what it actually is and what it can be but is not. ST I q.3 a.7 co. states the converse (in every composite there is potency and act), not this direction. The restriction to beings in act in some respect keeps pure potency out: prime matter, in potency and in act in no respect, is not composite.
